reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Title of act
headings.reviewNote: Cites sections 381.011 to 381.412 as the Missouri Title Insurance Act.

headings.title: Regulatory purpose under McCarran-Ferguson Act
headings.reviewNote: Specifies comprehensive regulation of title insurance business in response to federal McCarran-Ferguson Act.

headings.title: General insurance law applicability
headings.reviewNote: Applies general state insurance laws to title insurance, title insurers, and title agents.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 3 subsections and Effective 1-01-08 note against archived text; confirmed Missouri Title Insurance Act citation, McCarran-Ferguson regulatory purpose, and general insurance law applicability.

headings.title: Definition of title insurance commitment
headings.reviewNote: Defines title insurance commitment and distinguishes it from an abstract of title.

headings.title: Notice to purchaser-mortgagor regarding owner policy
headings.reviewNote: Requires written notice to purchaser-mortgagor when only lender policy requested; 15-year file retention.

headings.title: Level one violation classification
headings.reviewNote: Classifies violations of section as level one violations under section 374.049.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 3 subsections and Effective 1-01-08 note against archived text; confirmed title commitment definition, purchaser-mortgagor notice with 15-year file retention, and level one penalty.

headings.title: Written contract required for unaffiliated agency or agent
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits issuance of commitments or policies without written contract between parties.

headings.title: Policy number inventory maintenance
headings.reviewNote: Requires title insurer to maintain inventory of policy numbers allocated to agencies and agents.

headings.title: Verification of title agency or agent licensure
headings.reviewNote: Requires proof of agent or agency licensure on file prior to contract effectiveness.

headings.title: Underwriting guidelines and claims settlement limits
headings.reviewNote: Mandates insurer establish underwriting guidelines and claims settlement limitations in contracts.

headings.title: Notice to director upon contract termination
headings.reviewNote: Requires notice to director within seven days of terminating agency contract with reasons.

headings.title: Level two violation classification
headings.reviewNote: Classifies violations of section as level two violations under section 374.049.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 6 subsections and Effective 1-01-08 note against archived text; confirmed written agency contracts, policy number inventory, licensure proof, underwriting guidelines, 7-day termination notice, and level two penalty.

headings.title: Clear disclosure of premiums and settlement charges
headings.reviewNote: Requires disclosure of premiums, search fees, and settlement fees under RESPA-compliant rules.

headings.title: Level two violation classification
headings.reviewNote: Classifies violations of section as level two violations under section 374.049.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and Effective 1-01-08 note against archived text; confirmed RESPA-compatible disclosure of premiums, search fees, and closing fees, and level two penalty.

headings.title: Definitions of escrow, qualified depository, and security
headings.reviewNote: Defines escrow, qualified depository institution, and security or security deposit.

headings.title: Fiduciary account deposit deadline and fund segregation
headings.reviewNote: Requires deposit in separate fiduciary account by second business day and segregation of funds.

headings.title: Prohibited uses of escrow and security funds
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits commingling, debt payment, improper disbursements, and sets written disbursement conditions.

headings.title: Retention of bank credits and interest as compensation
headings.reviewNote: Allows title insurer, agency, or unaffiliated agent to retain bank credits, services, or interest as escrow administration compensation unless written instructions or statute state otherwise.

headings.title: Residential closing authorization and protection notice
headings.reviewNote: Restricts residential escrow/closing services unless commitment/policy and closing protection letters are issued, or approved written non-protection notice is given.

headings.title: Prohibition on residential closing without policy or notice
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits residential escrow/closing unless conducted with title policy and closing protection letter or prior clear disclosure of no title-insurer protection.

headings.title: Level three violation classification
headings.reviewNote: Classifies violations of this section as level three violations under section 374.049.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 7 subsections and history note against archived text; replaced mismatched subsections (4)–(7) titles/notes (bank credit retention, residential CPL/non-protection notices, level three penalty) and confirmed 2nd-business-day deposit and escrow prohibitions.

headings.title: Annual on-site review of contracted agencies and agents
headings.reviewNote: Mandates at least annual on-site insurer review of contracted agency/agent underwriting, claims, and escrow practices, verifying ascertainability of funds.

headings.title: On-site review standards, retention, and required findings
headings.reviewNote: Establishes on-site review standards, 4-year retention of work papers and reports, and 12 mandatory review findings including 3-way escrow reconciliation.

headings.title: Cooperation and liability exemption for shared agencies
headings.reviewNote: Permits multiple title insurers sharing an agency or agent to cooperate on reviews and exempts them from liability for sharing findings.

headings.title: Submission of review reports and director rulemaking
headings.reviewNote: Requires submitting copy of each review report to director and directs rulemaking on thresholds, standards, and report form.

headings.title: Level two violation classification
headings.reviewNote: Classifies violations of section as level two violations under section 374.049.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 5 subsections and Effective 1-01-08 note against archived text; replaced mismatched subsections (1)–(4) titles/notes to match annual on-site insurer reviews, 4-year retention/12 findings, multi-insurer cooperation, and director report/rulemaking.

headings.title: Prohibition on denying access or failing to cooperate
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits title agencies and unaffiliated agents from unreasonably denying access or failing to cooperate in underwriters' escrow/closing account reviews.

headings.title: Mandatory trust account access for appointing insurers
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits multi-insurer title agencies and unaffiliated agents from denying any appointing insurer access to fiduciary trust accounts and supporting information.

headings.title: Level two violation classification
headings.reviewNote: Classifies violations of section as level two violations under section 374.049.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 3 subsections and Effective 1-01-08 note against archived text; replaced mismatched subsections (1)–(2) titles/notes (drafted as E&O/bond) to match denial-of-access and fiduciary trust account access prohibitions.

headings.title: Definition of county to include city not within county
headings.reviewNote: Defines "county" or "counties" in this section to include any city not within a county.

headings.title: Permitted division of premiums and charges under RESPA
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies chapter does not prohibit division of premiums and charges among title insurers, agencies, and agents if compliant with RESPA (12 U.S.C. § 2601 et seq.).

headings.title: Level three violation classification for section 381.141
headings.reviewNote: Classifies violation of section 381.141* as level three violation under section 374.049; retains repeal/unconstitutionality footnote on S.B. 894 (2000).

headings.title: Private injunctive action after 45-day director inaction
headings.reviewNote: Permits same-county title entity to seek injunctive relief and attorney fees if director does not enforce section 381.141* within 45 days of written notice.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 4 subsections, Effective 1-01-08 note, and *§ 381.141 repeal/S.B. 894 unconstitutionality footnote; replaced all 4 mismatched draft titles/notes to match county definition, RESPA premium division, level three § 381.141* penalty, and 45-day private injunctive action.

headings.title: Five-business-day deadline for recording closing instruments
headings.reviewNote: Requires settlement agent to present deeds and security instruments for recording within five business days after conditions precedent unless all parties instruct otherwise.

headings.title: Pre-disbursement recording with written party consent
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies chapter does not prohibit recording before disbursement funds are available if all parties due payment consent in writing.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and Effective 1-01-08 note against archived text; replaced both mismatched draft titles/notes to match 5-business-day recording deadline and pre-disbursement recording with written consent.

headings.title: Definition of affiliated business
headings.reviewNote: Defines affiliated business regarding producer ownership or financial interest in title entity.

headings.title: Mandatory customer disclosure of affiliated business arrangement
headings.reviewNote: Requires written disclosure of affiliated relationship and estimated charges prior to transaction.

headings.title: Rules for reporting agency ownership interests
headings.reviewNote: Directs director to establish rules for recording and reporting agency owners and material transactions.

headings.title: Annual reports of producer financial interests
headings.reviewNote: Requires reporting names and addresses of persons with financial interests who are business producers.

headings.title: Conditions permitting affiliated business arrangements
headings.reviewNote: Permits affiliated arrangements conforming to disclosure, non-required use, and RESPA return on equity.

headings.title: Level two violation classification
headings.reviewNote: Classifies violations of section as level two violations under section 374.049.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 6 subsections and Effective 1-01-08 note against archived text; confirmed affiliated business definitions, customer disclosures, agency ownership reporting rules, RESPA conditions, and level two penalty.

headings.title: Definition of direct operations
headings.reviewNote: Defines direct operations as insurer operations attributable to business written by bona fide employee.

headings.title: Seven-year retention requirement for escrow and security records
headings.reviewNote: Requires preservation of escrow and security records for at least seven years after account closure.

headings.title: Premium remittance and policy issuance deadlines
headings.reviewNote: Requires premium remittance within 60 days of invoice and policy issuance within 45 days of commitment compliance.

headings.title: Exemption for coinsurers and reinsurers
headings.reviewNote: Exempts coinsurers where another coinsurer complies, and reinsurers from section.

headings.title: Level two violation classification
headings.reviewNote: Classifies violations of section as level two violations under section 374.049.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 5 subsections and Effective 1-01-08 note against archived text; confirmed direct operations definition, 7-year escrow record retention, 60-day remittance/45-day policy issuance, coinsurer/reinsurer exemption, and level two penalty.

headings.title: Rulemaking and regulatory orders authorized
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director under section 374.045 to issue rules and orders to carry out chapter.

headings.title: Compliance with chapter 536 and nonseverability clause
headings.reviewNote: Conditions rule effectiveness on chapter 536 and sets nonseverability clause for post-2008 rules.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and Effective 1-01-08 note against archived text; confirmed section 374.045 rulemaking authority and chapter 536/post-Jan 1, 2008 nonseverability clause.

headings.title: Administrative enforcement orders and producer license sanctions
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes administrative orders under section 374.046 and license suspension under section 375.141.

headings.title: Civil actions in circuit court for injunctive relief
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to maintain civil court action under section 374.048 for chapter violations.

headings.title: Cumulative nature of statutory insurance penalties
headings.reviewNote: Preserves director authority to impose other statutory penalties provided under insurance laws.

headings.title: Reservation of policyholder, claimant, and creditor rights
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies chapter does not limit or restrict rights of policyholders, claimants, or creditors.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 4 subsections and Effective 1-01-08 note against archived text; confirmed § 374.046 administrative orders/license sanctions, § 374.048 civil actions, cumulative penalties, and preservation of policyholder/creditor rights.

headings.title: Civil actions to enjoin federal RESPA violations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to bring action in court of competent jurisdiction to enjoin 12 U.S.C. 2607 violations.

headings.title: Level two violation classification for RESPA violations
headings.reviewNote: Classifies violations of federal Real Estate Settlement Procedures Act as level two violations.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and Effective 1-01-08 note against archived text; confirmed director injunctive actions for 12 U.S.C. § 2607 RESPA violations and level two classification.

headings.title: Single-line restriction to title insurance business
headings.reviewNote: Bars multi-line insurers from transacting title insurance and prohibits non-title business by title insurers.

headings.title: Prohibition on bond or mortgage principal and interest guarantees
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits title insurers from guaranteeing payment of principal or interest of bonds or mortgages.

headings.title: Closing or settlement protection letters, filed rates, and scope
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes closing protection letters in residential transactions, sets filing rules, and limits coverage.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 3 subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed single-line title restriction, mortgage/bond guarantee ban, and closing protection letter authorization, filed rates, and scope.

headings.title: Single risk net retained liability limitation
headings.reviewNote: Caps single risk liability at 50% of surplus plus statutory premium reserve less title plant investment.

headings.title: Calculation of single risk sum
headings.reviewNote: Defines single risk as insured amount and specifies calculation for multiple estates or reduced policies.

headings.title: Authority and capital requirements for obtaining reinsurance
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes reinsurance and requires $1.6 million combined capital and surplus for reinsurers.

headings.title: Director waiver of single risk limitation
headings.reviewNote: Allows director to waive single risk limitation upon insurer application for good cause shown.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 4 subsections and Effective 1-01-08 note against archived text; confirmed 50% surplus single-risk cap, single-risk sum calculation, $1.6M reinsurer capital requirement, and good-cause waiver.

headings.title: Title search and plant continuous record requirements
headings.reviewNote: Requires title search from county title plant or best evidence, and 27-year record chain; exempts attorneys.

headings.title: Prohibition on omitting outstanding recorded liens or interests
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits knowingly issuing owner policy or commitment without showing recorded liens unless allowed by rule.

headings.title: Fifteen-year retention period for title search evidence
headings.reviewNote: Requires preservation of title search and insurability evidence for at least 15 years in original or electronic form.

headings.title: Exceptions for reinsurance, coinsurers, and 1987 policies
headings.reviewNote: Exempts reinsurers, coinsurers when another coinsurer complied, and policies issued within one year after September 28, 1987.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 4 subsections and history note against archived text; corrected subsection (4) title/note (reinsurance, coinsurers, and pre-1988 policies) and confirmed 27-year title plant chain, attorney exemption, lien disclosure, and 15-year retention.

headings.title: Known claim, unearned premium, and supplemental reserves
headings.reviewNote: Mandates known claim reserve, statutory/unearned premium reserve (15 cents per $1,000, scheduled release), annual NAIC-compliant actuarial certification, and supplemental reserve.

headings.title: Reserve parity for foreign and alien title insurers
headings.reviewNote: Requires licensed foreign and alien title insurers to maintain at least domestic reserve levels on Missouri properties unless domiciliary law requires more.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and Effective 1-01-08 note against archived text; replaced both mismatched draft titles/notes (drafted as title plant maintenance) to match known claim, unearned premium, actuarial certification, supplemental, and foreign insurer reserves.

headings.title: Applicability of general insurer rehabilitation and liquidation laws
headings.reviewNote: Applies sections 375.570-375.750 and 375.1150-375.1246, directing court to consider title insurance uniqueness.

headings.title: Administration of security and escrow funds as secured claims
headings.reviewNote: Bars security and escrow funds from becoming general assets and treats them as secured claims.

headings.title: Restriction on policy cancellation during liquidation
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits cancellation of in-force policies in liquidation absent court finding of good cause.

headings.title: Claim filing deadlines established by court
headings.reviewNote: Empowers court to set separate claim filing deadlines for policy claims and general claims.

headings.title: Fully earned premiums upon insolvency and duty to pay
headings.reviewNote: Deems premiums fully earned upon insolvency order and requires payment to liquidator.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 5 subsections and Effective 1-01-08 note against archived text; confirmed insolvency/liquidation law applicability, secured-claim treatment of escrow funds, policy cancellation limits, claim deadlines, and fully earned premiums.

headings.title: Definitions of title search terms
headings.reviewNote: Defines search, search of public records, and search of title as searches of constructive notice records.

headings.title: Thirty-day prior filing requirement for standard policy forms
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits issuing standard title forms unless filed with director thirty days prior to use.

headings.title: Scope of covered title insurance forms
headings.reviewNote: Includes policies, endorsements, preliminary commitments, and closing protection letters.

headings.title: Filing requirement for non-survey terms and coverage conditions
headings.reviewNote: Requires filing terms, conditions, or exceptions other than survey or title search exceptions.

headings.title: Director review and sixty-day hearing procedure
headings.reviewNote: Provides 30-day director review and 60-day hearing procedure for nonconforming or ambiguous forms.

headings.title: Disapproval orders, judicial review, and waiting period
headings.reviewNote: Requires written disapproval order with findings under chapter 536, permitting judicial review.

headings.title: Non-disapproval not endorsement and misrepresentation ban
headings.reviewNote: Provides director failure to seek disapproval is not approval or endorsement and bars representing director approval of filed forms.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 7 subsections and Effective 1-01-08 note against archived text; corrected subsection (7) title/note (non-disapproval is not endorsement; representation of approval unlawful) and confirmed 30-day form filing and disapproval hearings.

headings.title: Authorization required to transact title insurance business
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits transacting title insurance business unless authorized as a title insurer, title agency, or title agent.

headings.title: Insurance producer licensing for title agencies and agents
headings.reviewNote: Requires business entity producer license (§ 375.015(2)) for title agencies and individual producer license (§ 375.015(1)) for nonexempt title agents.

headings.title: Licensure exemption for non-substantive salaried employees
headings.reviewNote: Exempts salaried employees who do not materially perform or supervise seven listed title insurance, search, policy execution, or escrow functions.

headings.title: Prohibition on insurer contracts with unlicensed entities
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits title insurers from contracting with unlicensed persons to act as title agency or agent for Missouri risks.

headings.title: Licensing rules, provisional waivers, and clerical work
headings.reviewNote: Directs licensing rulemaking, provisional licensure/waivers until January 1, 2010 for supervised new employees, and excludes supervised clerical staff.

headings.title: Agency business name limits and insurer reporting duty
headings.reviewNote: Bars "insurer", "insurance company", or "underwriter" in agency name unless "agency" is included, and requires timely reporting to title insurers.

headings.title: Ninety-day compliance period for existing licensees
headings.reviewNote: Grants title agencies and agents licensed prior to chapter effective date ninety days to comply with this section.

headings.title: Delegation of title searches to compliant third parties
headings.reviewNote: Requires compliance proof (effective 3 years) and record access before delegating title searches to third parties such as abstract companies.

headings.title: Level three violation classification
headings.reviewNote: Classifies violations of this section as level three violations under section 374.049.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 9 subsections and Effective 1-01-08 note against archived text; replaced all 9 mismatched/shifted draft titles/notes to match authorization, producer licensing, salaried employee exemptions, insurer contract ban, provisional rules, name rules, 90-day grace, third-party searches, and level three penalty.

headings.title: Examination requirement and 2008 grandfather waiver
headings.reviewNote: Requires qualified principal and title agents to pass producer advisory board exam, allowing good-cause waivers and waiving exam for agents/principals licensed Jan 1, 2008.

headings.title: Mandatory eight-hour biennial continuing education
headings.reviewNote: Requires nonexempt licensed title agents to complete at least eight hours of approved instruction every two years beginning January 1, 2008.

headings.title: Approval of course sponsors and Missouri Bar CLE credits
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes insurance associations, trade providers, and Missouri Bar CLE credits.

headings.title: Instructor continuing education credit
headings.reviewNote: Grants uncompensated instructors 1.5 times classroom credit hours once per year.

headings.title: Carryover of excess continuing education hours
headings.reviewNote: Allows excess classroom hours to carry forward to the immediately following two-year period.

headings.title: Extensions of time and hardship waivers
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes one-year extensions and waivers for military, illness, foreign residence, or age 70.

headings.title: Written certification of course completion
headings.reviewNote: Requires licensees to submit satisfactory written proof of completed continuing education.

headings.title: Reciprocity and non-resident title agent exemptions
headings.reviewNote: Exempts agents residing in states with mandatory CE; applies full rules to others.

headings.title: Promulgation of rules, advisory board, and course filing fees
headings.reviewNote: Directs rulemaking, consultation with producer advisory board, and $50 filing fee per course.

headings.title: Deposit of fees into insurance dedicated fund
headings.reviewNote: Requires transmission of fees to state treasury for credit of insurance dedicated fund.

headings.title: Biennial renewal fee and certification submission
headings.reviewNote: Mandates submission of written CE certification concurrent with biennial renewal fee.

headings.title: Compliance with chapter 536 and nonseverability clause
headings.reviewNote: Conditions rule validity on chapter 536 and establishes post-2008 nonseverability.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 12 subsections and Effective 1-01-08 note against archived text; corrected subsections (1)–(2) titles/notes (qualified principal/agent exam with Jan 1, 2008 waiver; 8-hour biennial CE) and confirmed approved courses, instructor credit, waivers, fees, and nonseverability.

headings.title: Prohibition on conditioning financing or sale on specific title insurer
headings.reviewNote: Bars lenders and property sellers from conditioning loans or sales on using a specific title agency or insurer.

headings.title: Level three violation classification
headings.reviewNote: Classifies violations of section as level three violations under section 374.049.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and Effective 1-01-08 note against archived text; confirmed anti-tying prohibition for specific title agents/agencies/insurers and level three penalty.

headings.title: Definitions for construction guaranty and closing provisions
headings.reviewNote: Defines construction completion guaranty, deposit guaranty, escrow agreement, insured closing letter, and licensee.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified subsection (1) and history note against archived text; confirmed five definitions for construction guaranties, escrow agreements, insured closing letters, and licensees under §§ 381.400–381.405.

headings.title: Certified funds requirement for real estate closing disbursements
headings.reviewNote: Requires certified funds for amounts over $2,500; exempts broker/title escrows, governments, and banks.

headings.title: Disbursement conditions for public settlement escrow accounts
headings.reviewNote: Bars escrow disbursements unless corresponding deposit was made 10 days prior, in certified funds, or by exempt check; retains footnote noting repeal of § 381.009* by S.B. 66 (2007).

headings.title: Level two violation classification
headings.reviewNote: Classifies violations of section as level two violations under section 374.049.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 3 subsections, Effective 6-10-08 note, and *§ 381.009 repeal footnote; confirmed $2,500 certified funds rule, 10-day/certified/exempt check disbursement rules, and level two penalty.
